words.enDefinition: Cash required upfront to start and equip a proposed project

examples.en: The initial investment outlay included delivery and the cost of modifying the installation site.
examples.zh: 「项目初始投资支出」包括送货费和改造安装场地的费用。

examples.en: We placed the initial investment outlay before the first year of operating receipts.
examples.zh: 我们把「项目初始投资支出」放在第一年营业收款之前。

collocations: an initial investment outlay at time zero
include costs in the initial investment outlay

words.enDefinition: Sales lost by existing products because customers switch to a new offering

examples.en: The two drink sizes showed cannibalization when customers switched to the larger one.
examples.zh: 顾客转买大杯后，两种规格的饮品出现了「新品挤占原产品销售」的情况。

examples.en: The case estimated cannibalization alongside total sales from the proposed campus outlet.
examples.zh: 案例估算了拟开校园门店的总销量，也估算了「新品挤占原产品销售」。

collocations: sales cannibalization within a product line

words.enDefinition: Comparison of estimated outcomes if a project proceeds or does not

examples.en: Our with-and-without analysis compared the proposed equipment with keeping the current machines.
examples.zh: 我们的「有无项目比较分析」对照了采购拟议设备和保留现有机器两种情形。

examples.en: The instructor used a with-and-without analysis to separate new receipts from existing sales.
examples.zh: 老师通过「有无项目比较分析」把新增收入和现有销售收入分开了。

words.enDefinition: Rent a project sponsor gives up by using its own property

examples.en: The model listed foregone rental income because the project would occupy an empty shop.
examples.zh: 模型列了「放弃的租金收入」，因为项目会占用一间空店面。

examples.en: Our case included foregone rental income from a room previously leased to another group.
examples.zh: 案例计入了原先租给另一个团队的房间所对应的「放弃的租金收入」。

collocations: foregone rental income from unused space

words.enDefinition: Indirect operating costs that disappear if an activity stops or changes

examples.en: The case counted the temporary cleaning contract as avoidable overhead for the studio.
examples.zh: 案例把这间工作室的临时清洁合同计作「可避免的间接费用」。

examples.en: We included avoidable overhead when comparing whether to keep the extra facility open.
examples.zh: 我们比较是否继续开放额外场地时，计入了「可避免的间接费用」。

collocations: exclude unavoidable costs from avoidable overhead

words.enDefinition: A share of common costs assigned to a product or activity

examples.en: The allocated overhead appeared on the cost sheet even though total rent stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 尽管房租总额没变，成本表上仍列出了「分摊的间接费用」。

examples.en: Our group checked whether the allocated overhead represented any new cash spending.
examples.zh: 我们组核对了「分摊的间接费用」是否对应新增现金支出。

collocations: include allocated overhead in a cost sheet
exclude allocated overhead from cash flows

words.enDefinition: Cash freed when a project no longer needs previously committed funds

examples.en: The working capital release occurred when inventory was sold and customer balances were collected.
examples.zh: 存货售出、应收款收回后，发生了「营运资金释放」。

examples.en: The closing date mattered because the worksheet placed a working capital release there.
examples.zh: 结项日期很重要，因为练习表把「营运资金释放」列在那一天。

collocations: a working capital release at closure

words.enDefinition: A period’s increase or decrease in short-term operating assets less liabilities

examples.en: A rise in inventory increased the change in net working capital in our example.
examples.zh: 示例里，库存上升让「净营运资金变动额」变大了。

examples.en: We treated the positive change in net working capital as a use of cash.
examples.zh: 我们把正值的「净营运资金变动额」视为现金占用。

collocations: calculate the change in net working capital
forecast a change in net working capital
show the change in net working capital

words.enDefinition: Additional tax owed because a proposed decision changes taxable results

examples.en: The model showed incremental tax liability after the project began to earn taxable profit.
examples.zh: 项目开始产生应税利润后，模型显示了「增量纳税义务」。

examples.en: We separated incremental tax liability from the company's existing tax bill in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上把「增量纳税义务」与公司原有的应纳税额分开了。

words.enDefinition: A reduction in tax payable resulting from deductible depreciation

examples.en: The worksheet included a depreciation tax shield even though depreciation itself used no cash.
examples.zh: 尽管折旧本身不耗用现金，练习表仍列出了「折旧税盾」。

examples.en: A different depreciation schedule changed when the depreciation tax shield appeared in our model.
examples.zh: 改用另一套折旧计划后，模型中的「折旧税盾」出现时间变了。

collocations: the value of the depreciation tax shield

words.enDefinition: An adjustment reversing a noncash expense when calculating cash flow

examples.en: We included a non-cash add-back for depreciation after working out operating profit.
examples.zh: 我们算完营业利润后，做了一笔折旧的「非现金项目加回」。

examples.en: The template showed a non-cash add-back between operating profit and operating cash flow.
examples.zh: 模板在营业利润与经营现金流之间列了「非现金项目加回」。

words.enDefinition: Tax savings available when interest expense can reduce taxable income

examples.en: The interest tax shield appeared on a separate line in the financing worksheet.
examples.zh: 融资练习表单列了「利息税盾」。

examples.en: Our exercise compared the interest tax shield under two hypothetical borrowing amounts.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们比较了两种假设借款金额下的「利息税盾」。

collocations: the present value of the interest tax shield

words.enDefinition: Cash recovered from selling an asset after related taxes are accounted for

examples.en: We included after-tax salvage value in the last column of the project worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在项目练习表的最后一栏计入了「税后残值收入」。

examples.en: The class calculated after-tax salvage value after estimating what the used equipment would sell for.
examples.zh: 全班先估算旧设备卖多少钱，再计算「税后残值收入」。

collocations: include after-tax salvage value at closure

words.enDefinition: An asset's remaining value after tax depreciation or allowances are deducted

examples.en: The case compared tax written-down value with the amount received for the old machine.
examples.zh: 案例对照了「税务折余价值」和旧机器的卖出金额。

examples.en: Our notes listed tax written-down value separately from the figure in the accounting records.
examples.zh: 笔记把「税务折余价值」与会计账簿里的数值分开列出。

collocations: compare tax written-down value with sale price

words.enDefinition: Cash inflows and outflows arising at the end of a project

examples.en: The terminal cash flow included final equipment sales and the cost of restoring the site.
examples.zh: 「期末现金流」包括最后的设备出售收入和场地恢复费用。

examples.en: I moved the expected refund into terminal cash flow on the sample worksheet.
examples.zh: 我把预计退款移到练习表样本的「期末现金流」一栏。

words.enDefinition: The expense of taking an asset out of service safely

examples.en: The feasibility case included a decommissioning cost once the plant stopped operating.
examples.zh: 可行性案例列出了工厂停运后的「退役拆除成本」。

examples.en: The team increased the decommissioning cost after reading the fictional site closure plan.
examples.zh: 团队看过虚构的场地关闭计划后，提高了「退役拆除成本」的估算。

words.enDefinition: Cost of returning land or a site to a required condition

examples.en: The site restoration cost was separate from the amount budgeted for dismantling equipment.
examples.zh: 「场地恢复成本」和用于拆除设备的预算金额是分开列的。

examples.en: The example placed the site restoration cost in the final year of the model.
examples.zh: 范例把「场地恢复成本」放在模型的最后一年。

words.enDefinition: Capital spending needed to keep existing operations functioning at capacity

examples.en: The forecast included maintenance capex for replacing worn pumps at the facility.
examples.zh: 预测中列了为更换设施旧泵而支出的「维持运营的资本支出」。

examples.en: We kept maintenance capex separate from the proposed addition of a new production line.
examples.zh: 我们把「维持运营的资本支出」和计划新增一条生产线的开支分开了。

words.enDefinition: Capital spending intended to expand capacity or grow an operation

examples.en: The case classified the second production building as growth capex in the budget.
examples.zh: 案例把第二栋生产楼的开支列为预算中的「扩张性资本支出」。

examples.en: The model showed growth capex rising when the new line was built.
examples.zh: 建新生产线时，模型显示「扩张性资本支出」有所上升。

words.enDefinition: A timeline showing when planned capital expenditures will be paid

examples.en: The capital spending schedule put the equipment deposit in a different month from installation.
examples.zh: 「资本支出进度表」把设备定金和安装支出列在不同月份。

examples.en: Our group adjusted the capital spending schedule after the delivery date moved back.
examples.zh: 交货日期推迟后，我们组调整了「资本支出进度表」。

collocations: payments in a capital spending schedule

words.zhGloss: 不含融资的项目现金流
words.enDefinition: cash flow from a project before the effects of its particular financing choices, such as debt proceeds, principal repayments and interest
acceptedZhAnswers: 不含融资的项目现金流

examples.en: The model showed unlevered project cash flow before adding any borrowing costs to the analysis.
examples.zh: 模型先列「不含融资的项目现金流」，之后才分析借款成本。

examples.en: We compared unlevered project cash flow across two projects with different proposed borrowing terms.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个拟议贷款条款不同的项目各自的「不含融资的项目现金流」。

words.enDefinition: Cash available to project equity holders after accounting for debt flows

examples.en: The cash flow to equity changed after we added a principal repayment to the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把一笔本金偿还填进练习表后，「股东权益现金流」变了。

examples.en: The exercise showed cash flow to equity beside the funds available before debt payments.
examples.zh: 练习里，「股东权益现金流」旁边列出了偿债前可用资金。

words.enDefinition: Cash flow stated in future money amounts including assumed inflation

examples.en: The nominal cash flow for year three included the assumed increase in prices.
examples.zh: 第三年的「名义现金流」计入了预估涨价。

examples.en: We matched nominal cash flow to the discount rate stated in nominal terms.
examples.zh: 我们把「名义现金流」与用名义口径表示的折现率配对。

words.zhGloss: 实际购买力口径现金流
words.enDefinition: Cash flow expressed at constant purchasing power rather than future prices
acceptedZhAnswers: 实际购买力口径现金流

examples.en: The real cash flow used the first year's prices in every forecast year.
examples.zh: 「实际购买力口径现金流」在每个预测年度都使用第一年的价格。

examples.en: Our tutor matched real cash flow with a rate that excluded expected inflation.
examples.zh: 导师把「实际购买力口径现金流」和未计入预期通胀的利率配对。

words.enDefinition: A price or cost increase built in to reflect inflation

examples.en: The maintenance fee included inflation escalation in every year of the forecast.
examples.zh: 预测设定每年的维护费「按通胀递增」。

examples.en: We reviewed the inflation escalation assumption before comparing two versions of the same bid.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「按通胀递增」的假设，再比较同一竞标方案的两个版本。

words.enDefinition: A projection using prices from a single base period throughout

examples.en: The constant-price forecast kept the unit price unchanged to isolate expected volume growth.
examples.zh: 「不变价格预测」保持单价不变，以便单独观察预计销量增长。

examples.en: We noted the base year before reading the constant-price forecast in the case.
examples.zh: 阅读案例中的「不变价格预测」之前，我们记下了基准年份。

collocations: the base year in a constant-price forecast

words.enDefinition: A model rule for assigning cash flows to specified dates

examples.en: Our cash flow timing convention assumed all payments were received at the end of each year.
examples.zh: 我们的「现金流计时惯例」假设所有款项都在各年年末收到。

examples.en: The handout stated the cash flow timing convention before showing the discount factors.
examples.zh: 讲义先写明「现金流计时惯例」，再列折现因子。

collocations: choose a cash flow timing convention
state the cash flow timing convention
change a cash flow timing convention

words.enDefinition: A valuation convention treating annual cash flows as occurring midyear

examples.en: The class applied the midyear convention when the example cash arrived throughout the year.
examples.zh: 示例现金在全年陆续到账时，全班采用了「年中现金流折现惯例」。

examples.en: We changed the time column to reflect the midyear convention on our sheet.
examples.zh: 我们改了表上的时间栏，使它反映「年中现金流折现惯例」。

collocations: value a project under the midyear convention

words.enDefinition: The reference date to which future cash flows are discounted

examples.en: The base date in our model was the day the investment was approved.
examples.zh: 我们模型的「折现基准日期」是投资获批的那天。

examples.en: We checked the base date before comparing values from the two schedules.
examples.zh: 比较两份表的数值前，我们核对了「折现基准日期」。

collocations: discount cash flows to the base date

words.enDefinition: The span of time covered by projected project cash flows

examples.en: The cash flow forecast period ended after five years of planned equipment use in this example.
examples.zh: 本例中，「现金流预测期」在设备计划使用满五年后结束。

examples.en: We shortened the cash flow forecast period after the class changed the assumed lease length.
examples.zh: 全班修改了假设租期后，我们缩短了「现金流预测期」。

collocations: define a cash flow forecast period
extend the cash flow forecast period
the end of the cash flow forecast period

words.enDefinition: Time needed for accumulated discounted inflows to recover the investment

examples.en: The discounted payback period extended beyond year three after we applied a discount rate.
examples.zh: 应用折现率后，「折现回收期」超过了第三年。

examples.en: Our tutor contrasted the discounted payback period with the estimate based on undiscounted receipts.
examples.zh: 导师把「折现回收期」与按未折现收款算出的估计值作了对照。

words.enDefinition: Present value of future net cash flows divided by initial investment

examples.en: The profitability index showed discounted net inflows relative to each project’s upfront cost.
examples.zh: 「获利指数」显示各项目折现后现金净流入与初始投资额的比率。

examples.en: The class compared the profitability index for two proposals needing different upfront amounts.
examples.zh: 全班比较了两项初始支出不同的方案所对应的「获利指数」。

collocations: a project with a higher profitability index

words.enDefinition: A project return measure using specified financing and reinvestment rates

examples.en: The formula for modified internal rate of return used two separate rate assumptions in our model.
examples.zh: 我们模型里的「修正内部收益率」公式用了两个单列的利率假设。

examples.en: I checked the modified internal rate of return after changing the reinvestment input in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我在练习中更改再投资利率后，核对了「修正内部收益率」。

collocations: calculate the modified internal rate of return
report the modified internal rate of return
a higher modified internal rate of return

words.enDefinition: The rate a model assumes for reinvesting cash received before completion

examples.en: The reinvestment rate assumption applied to interim cash receipts in the sample calculation.
examples.zh: 算例对中途收到的现金应用了「再投资利率假设」。

examples.en: The seminar tested a lower reinvestment rate assumption and compared the two results.
examples.zh: 研讨课测试了较低的「再投资利率假设」，并比较两种结果。

words.zhGloss: 符号多次变化的现金流
words.enDefinition: A series of cash flows that changes sign more than once
acceptedZhAnswers: 符号多次变化的现金流

examples.en: The example showed non-conventional cash flow after a final cleanup payment followed operating receipts.
examples.zh: 示例中，营业收款后还要付最后的清理费，于是形成了「符号多次变化的现金流」。

examples.en: We looked for sign changes to identify non-conventional cash flow on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们通过观察收支符号的变化来识别练习表中的「符号多次变化的现金流」。

collocations: a pattern of non-conventional cash flow

words.enDefinition: Multiple rates that each make the same project’s net present value zero

examples.en: The model gave multiple internal rates of return for the project with a large final outflow.
examples.zh: 模型对期末有大笔现金流出的那个项目给出了「多个内部收益率」。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the curve to illustrate why multiple internal rates of return could arise.
examples.zh: 导师画了条曲线来说明为什么可能出现「多个内部收益率」。

collocations: produce multiple internal rates of return
a case with multiple internal rates of return
test for multiple internal rates of return

words.enDefinition: A graph showing net present value at different discount rates

examples.en: Our NPV profile sloped downward as the discount rate rose in the example.
examples.zh: 本例中，折现率上升时我们的「净现值曲线」向下倾斜。

examples.en: The class drew an NPV profile for each of the two proposed machines.
examples.zh: 全班为两台拟采购设备分别画了「净现值曲线」。

words.zhGloss: 项目净现值交叉折现率
words.enDefinition: The discount rate at which two projects have equal net present values
acceptedZhAnswers: 项目净现值交叉折现率

examples.en: The two plotted lines met at the crossover rate in our graph.
examples.zh: 在我们画的图里，两条线在「项目净现值交叉折现率」处相交。

examples.en: We compared project rankings above and below the crossover rate in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上比较了高于和低于「项目净现值交叉折现率」时的项目排序。

collocations: compare project ranks around the crossover rate

words.enDefinition: Investment alternatives where choosing one rules out choosing another

examples.en: The machines were mutually exclusive projects because they both needed the only available space.
examples.zh: 两台机器都需要唯一可用的空间，因此对应的方案是「相互排斥的项目」。

examples.en: Our worksheet asked how the values of mutually exclusive projects would be compared.
examples.zh: 练习表问，应怎样比较「相互排斥的项目」的价值。

words.enDefinition: Investments whose selection does not depend on each other

examples.en: The facilities were independent projects in our exercise because either could open alone.
examples.zh: 在练习中，两处设施都可以单独开放，所以是「可独立选择的项目」。

examples.en: The example ranked independent projects separately within the available total budget.
examples.zh: 示例在可用总预算内对各「可独立选择的项目」分别排序。

words.enDefinition: A disagreement about which project ranks higher under different selection measures

examples.en: Our chart showed a project ranking conflict when the two measures preferred different machines.
examples.zh: 两种指标分别偏向不同机器，我们的图里就出现了「项目排序冲突」。

examples.en: The class traced the project ranking conflict to differences in the timing of receipts.
examples.zh: 全班发现，这次「项目排序冲突」源于收到现金的时间不同。

words.enDefinition: A ranking difference caused by the sizes of the investments compared

examples.en: The scale effect explained why the smaller project ranked higher by return but lower by value.
examples.zh: 「投资规模效应」解释了为什么较小的项目按收益率排得靠前，按价值排得靠后。

examples.en: Our tutor used the initial spending figures to illustrate the scale effect.
examples.zh: 导师用初始支出数据说明了「投资规模效应」。

collocations: a scale effect in project appraisal

words.enDefinition: Limiting total investment and choosing projects within the available budget

examples.en: The exercise introduced capital rationing by giving every group the same spending ceiling.
examples.zh: 练习给各组设了相同的支出上限，以此说明「资本限额分配」。

examples.en: We compared two project combinations under capital rationing in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习表中比较了「资本限额分配」下的两种项目组合。

words.enDefinition: An investment spending limit set internally by the organisation

examples.en: The board's voluntary spending cap illustrated soft capital rationing in the classroom case.
examples.zh: 董事会自设的支出上限说明了课堂案例中的「内部资本限额」。

examples.en: The model treated the budget ceiling as soft capital rationing because management could revise it.
examples.zh: 管理层可以修改预算上限，所以模型把它归类为「内部资本限额」。

collocations: an example of soft capital rationing
distinguish soft capital rationing from external constraints

words.zhGloss: 外部融资造成的资本限额
words.enDefinition: An investment spending limit imposed by constraints on outside financing
acceptedZhAnswers: 外部融资造成的资本限额

examples.en: The model treated the ceiling as hard capital rationing because lenders would advance nothing more.
examples.zh: 放贷机构无法提供更多资金，所以模型把该上限归为「外部融资造成的资本限额」。

examples.en: We listed financing limits before identifying hard capital rationing in the hypothetical case.
examples.zh: 在假设案例中判断是否存在「外部融资造成的资本限额」前，我们先列出了融资限制。

collocations: an example of hard capital rationing

words.enDefinition: A project that must be accepted or rejected as a whole

examples.en: The new machine was an indivisible project because buying half would achieve nothing.
examples.zh: 那项新设备采购是个「不可拆分实施的项目」，只买半台并无用处。

examples.en: Our model assigned either the full cost or zero to each indivisible project.
examples.zh: 我们的模型对每个「不可拆分实施的项目」要么计入全额成本，要么计零。

words.enDefinition: An annual stream whose present value equals a project's net present value

examples.en: We used an equivalent annual annuity to compare projects with different useful lives.
examples.zh: 我们用「等额年度现金流」比较使用年限不同的项目。

examples.en: The class calculated an equivalent annual annuity for each option on the sheet.
examples.zh: 全班算出了表上各选项的「等额年度现金流」。

collocations: express value as an equivalent annual annuity

words.enDefinition: A constant annual cost whose present value matches total discounted costs

examples.en: The equivalent annual cost let us compare machines that lasted different numbers of years.
examples.zh: 「等额年成本」让我们可以比较使用年限不同的机器。

examples.en: I checked whether maintenance was included in the equivalent annual cost in our example.
examples.zh: 我核对了示例中的「等额年成本」是否计入了维护费。

collocations: an equivalent annual cost per machine

words.enDefinition: A method comparing repeated projects over a shared time horizon

examples.en: The replacement chain approach repeated the shorter project until both options ended together.
examples.zh: 「连续重置比较法」重复计算期限较短的项目，直到两项方案同时结束。

examples.en: We identified the repeatability assumption behind the replacement chain approach in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们找出了练习表的「连续重置比较法」所采用的可重复实施假设。

collocations: assumptions in the replacement chain approach

words.enDefinition: Evaluation of whether replacing an existing asset changes future costs or benefits

examples.en: The worksheet used replacement analysis to compare keeping the older machine with replacing it.
examples.zh: 练习表用「设备更换分析」比较了保留原设备和更换设备。

examples.en: Our group included the old equipment's sale in its replacement analysis.
examples.zh: 我们组在「设备更换分析」中计入了旧设备出售这一项。

words.enDefinition: Project value without debt plus present value of financing effects

examples.en: The adjusted present value calculation valued the project before adding the financing effects.
examples.zh: 「调整现值」的计算先估算项目自身价值，再加入融资影响。

examples.en: Our worksheet used adjusted present value when the planned debt balance changed over time.
examples.zh: 计划债务余额随时间变化时，练习表用到了「调整现值」。

words.enDefinition: A discount rate that reflects the risk of particular cash flows

examples.en: The riskier proposal had a higher risk-adjusted discount rate in the lecture example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，风险较高的方案用了更高的「风险调整折现率」。

examples.en: We checked which projected cash flows the risk-adjusted discount rate was meant to value.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「风险调整折现率」要用于估算哪些预测现金流的价值。

words.enDefinition: A certain amount judged equivalent in value to an uncertain outcome

examples.en: The tutor replaced the risky receipt with a certainty equivalent in the example.
examples.zh: 导师在示例中用「确定性等价额」替代了有风险的收款。

examples.en: We compared the certainty equivalent with the mean amount across possible outcomes.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「确定性等价额」和各种可能结果的平均金额。

words.enDefinition: The sales or activity level at which net present value equals zero

examples.en: The financial break-even point was expressed as annual units sold in our spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 表格用年度销量表示了「财务盈亏平衡点」。

examples.en: The class compared the financial break-even point with the sales level where operating profit vanished.
examples.zh: 全班比较了「财务盈亏平衡点」和营业利润变为零时的销量。

collocations: a financial break-even point in units

words.zhGloss: 使评估结论改变的临界值
words.enDefinition: An input level at which a preferred option or conclusion changes
acceptedZhAnswers: 使评估结论改变的临界值

examples.en: The switching value showed how low demand would have to fall to change the ranking.
examples.zh: 「使评估结论改变的临界值」显示，需求得降到多低才会改变排序。

examples.en: We found the switching value by varying the cost in our classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们改变课堂模型里的成本，找出了「使评估结论改变的临界值」。

words.enDefinition: Testing how an outcome changes when a single assumption changes

examples.en: The one-way sensitivity analysis changed only projected sales while other inputs stayed fixed.
examples.zh: 「单因素敏感性分析」只改变了预测销量，其余输入值保持不变。

examples.en: We used one-way sensitivity analysis to see which demand assumption mattered most.
examples.zh: 我们用「单因素敏感性分析」看哪项需求假设影响最大。

collocations: a one-way sensitivity analysis of costs

words.enDefinition: A bar chart ranking inputs by their impact on model results

examples.en: The tornado chart showed demand as the largest source of variation in value.
examples.zh: 「敏感性龙卷风图」显示，需求是价值变化幅度最大的因素。

examples.en: Our tutor asked what the widest bar in the tornado chart represented.
examples.zh: 导师问「敏感性龙卷风图」里最长的条代表什么。

words.enDefinition: Repeated random sampling from input distributions to estimate possible outcomes

examples.en: The Monte Carlo simulation generated a range of project values in the exercise.
examples.zh: 「蒙特卡洛模拟」在练习中得出了一系列可能的项目价值。

examples.en: We checked the input distributions before running the Monte Carlo simulation in class.
examples.zh: 在课上运行「蒙特卡洛模拟」之前，我们先核对了输入变量的分布。

collocations: inputs for a Monte Carlo simulation

words.enDefinition: evaluating sequential financial choices by assigning probabilities and cash-flow consequences to different branches

examples.en: The decision tree analysis showed one decision after demand had become clearer.
examples.zh: 「决策树分析」显示，在需求更明确后才作出其中一项决策。

examples.en: Our team used decision tree analysis to evaluate cash flows from renewing a supply contract.
examples.zh: 我们组用「决策树分析」评估了续签供货合同产生的现金流。

collocations: a decision tree analysis of expansion

words.enDefinition: Flexibility to delay a project until more information becomes available

examples.en: The example valued an option to defer while the team waited for new information.
examples.zh: 范例估算了团队等待新信息期间「延后投资选择权」的价值。

examples.en: The worksheet included an option to defer alongside the immediate investment case.
examples.zh: 练习表把「延后投资选择权」和立即投资的情况并列展示。

words.enDefinition: Flexibility to stop a project and avoid continuing exposure or costs

examples.en: The case included an abandonment option if demand turned out much lower.
examples.zh: 案例考虑了需求远低于预期时的「放弃项目选择权」。

examples.en: Our diagram showed where the abandonment option entered the sequence of decisions.
examples.zh: 图上显示「放弃项目选择权」出现在决策顺序的哪个位置。

collocations: a project with an abandonment option

words.zhGloss: 扩大项目规模的选择权
words.enDefinition: Flexibility to increase a project's scale if future conditions warrant it
acceptedZhAnswers: 扩大项目规模的选择权

examples.en: An expansion option appeared on the branch where demand exceeded expectations.
examples.zh: 「扩大项目规模的选择权」出现在需求高于预期的分支上。

examples.en: The class valued an expansion option for adding capacity after the trial phase.
examples.zh: 全班估算了试行结束后追加产能的「扩大项目规模的选择权」的价值。

words.enDefinition: A separate entity created for a defined transaction or project

examples.en: The case placed the project's assets in a special purpose vehicle before financing.
examples.zh: 案例在融资前把项目资产放在一个「特殊目的实体」名下。

examples.en: Our tutor drew the special purpose vehicle between the sponsors and lenders.
examples.zh: 导师在发起人与贷款机构之间画出了「特殊目的实体」。

collocations: set up a special purpose vehicle
finance through a special purpose vehicle

words.enDefinition: Project borrowing permitting claims against sponsors only in defined circumstances

examples.en: The case used limited recourse financing with sponsor support confined to the construction phase.
examples.zh: 案例采用「有限追索融资」，发起人只在施工阶段提供支持。

examples.en: Our class identified which liabilities were covered under the limited recourse financing.
examples.zh: 全班找出了「有限追索融资」中发起人需要承担哪些责任。

words.enDefinition: Borrowing where lenders rely on project assets and revenues for repayment

examples.en: The non-recourse financing in our example rested on revenues from the facility.
examples.zh: 示例中的「无追索融资」依靠设施产生的收入偿还。

examples.en: The worksheet asked which assets supported the non-recourse financing in the case.
examples.zh: 练习表问，案例中哪些资产为「无追索融资」提供保障？

words.enDefinition: Ownership capital provided to a project by its sponsors

examples.en: The model showed sponsor equity covering part of the initial construction costs.
examples.zh: 模型显示，「发起人股本出资」承担了部分初始施工费用。

examples.en: Our funding table listed sponsor equity alongside the bank loan in separate rows.
examples.zh: 我们的资金表把「发起人股本出资」与银行贷款分行列出。

words.enDefinition: A promise to provide a defined amount of ownership capital

examples.en: The equity commitment stated how much the sponsor would contribute to the project.
examples.zh: 「股本出资承诺」写明发起人将为项目出资多少。

examples.en: We noted when the equity commitment would have to be funded in the example.
examples.zh: 我们记下了示例中「股本出资承诺」必须实际缴款的时间。

words.enDefinition: Temporary borrowing that covers equity funding until the sponsors contribute it

examples.en: The example used an equity bridge loan before the sponsor paid its promised contribution.
examples.zh: 示例在发起人缴付承诺的出资前，使用了「股本出资过桥贷款」。

examples.en: We traced the repayment of the equity bridge loan to the later equity payment.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「股本出资过桥贷款」的还款记录，找到了后来缴付的股本。

words.zhGloss: 股东借给项目公司的贷款
words.enDefinition: A loan made by a shareholder to the company it owns
acceptedZhAnswers: 股东借给项目公司的贷款

examples.en: The worksheet put a shareholder loan below the bank facility in the funding table.
examples.zh: 练习表在资金表的银行授信下方列了一笔「股东借给项目公司的贷款」。

examples.en: Our class compared a shareholder loan with an ordinary share contribution from the sponsor.
examples.zh: 全班把「股东借给项目公司的贷款」和发起人的普通股出资作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A financing table showing where capital comes from and goes

examples.en: Our sources and uses table listed each funding source beside the proposed project costs.
examples.zh: 我们的「资金来源与用途表」把各项资金来源与拟议项目成本并列。

examples.en: The class used the sources and uses table to check that construction costs were covered.
examples.zh: 全班用「资金来源与用途表」核对施工成本是否都有资金覆盖。

collocations: prepare a sources and uses table
balance a sources and uses table
review a sources and uses table

words.enDefinition: A loan arrangement repaid ahead of debt with lower priority

examples.en: The senior facility appeared above other debt in the example financing summary.
examples.zh: 示例融资摘要把「优先级融资额度」列在其他债务上方。

examples.en: I checked the schedule for the first repayment under the senior facility.
examples.zh: 我查了进度表，确定「优先级融资额度」项下第一笔还款在哪。

collocations: repay amounts under a senior facility

words.enDefinition: A fee paid for a lender's commitment to make funds available

examples.en: Our forecast charged a commitment fee on the amount still available to draw.
examples.zh: 预测对尚可支用的额度计收了「授信承诺费」。

examples.en: The class separated the commitment fee from the interest charged on drawn funds.
examples.zh: 全班把「授信承诺费」和已提款项产生的利息区分开。

collocations: charge a commitment fee on undrawn funds

words.zhGloss: 已承诺而未提用的额度
words.enDefinition: Credit promised by a lender that the borrower has not used
acceptedZhAnswers: 已承诺而未提用的额度

examples.en: The undrawn commitment shrank when the project borrowed more under its facility.
examples.zh: 项目从授信额度中又借了一部分后，「已承诺而未提用的额度」减少了。

examples.en: We compared the undrawn commitment with construction payments still due in the model.
examples.zh: 我们把「已承诺而未提用的额度」与模型尚需支付的建设款作了对照。

collocations: a fee on the undrawn commitment

words.enDefinition: A timeline for borrowing money in parts under an agreed facility

examples.en: The drawdown schedule reflected when equipment suppliers expected to be paid.
examples.zh: 「贷款提款进度表」反映了设备供应商预计收款的时间。

examples.en: We updated the drawdown schedule after the first construction invoice arrived later.
examples.zh: 第一张工程发票晚到后，我们更新了「贷款提款进度表」。

collocations: compare the drawdown schedule with spending

words.enDefinition: Borrowing interest accruing while the funded asset is being built

examples.en: The model calculated interest during construction before the plant began to earn revenue.
examples.zh: 模型计算了工厂开始取得收入前的「建设期利息」。

examples.en: We moved interest during construction into the financing section of the project worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「建设期利息」移到了项目练习表的融资一栏。

words.enDefinition: Eligible borrowing costs included in an asset's cost as it develops

examples.en: The example separated capitalized borrowing costs from borrowing expenses charged in the period.
examples.zh: 示例把「已资本化的借款费用」和计入当期的借款费用分开。

examples.en: Our class found capitalized borrowing costs in the note explaining the new asset's value.
examples.zh: 全班在说明新资产价值的附注里找到了「已资本化的借款费用」。

words.enDefinition: Credit available to cover eligible costs above a project's agreed budget

examples.en: The contract listed a cost overrun facility beside the main construction loan.
examples.zh: 合同把「超支备用融资额度」列在主要建设贷款旁边。

examples.en: We checked when the cost overrun facility could be used in the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构的协议里查看了何时可以使用「超支备用融资额度」。

collocations: draw on a cost overrun facility

words.expression: cash flow available for debt service
words.lemma: cash flow available for debt service
words.enDefinition: cash flow a project has available to pay principal and interest after operating costs and other adjustments specified in the model or financing terms
acceptedEnVariants: cash flow available for debt service

examples.en: The model compared cash flow available for debt service with principal and interest due that year.
examples.zh: 模型将「可用于偿债的现金流」与当年应付的本金和利息作了对照。

examples.en: Our cash flow available for debt service declined after cash operating expenses rose in the case.
examples.zh: 在案例中，经营现金支出上升后，我们的「可用于偿债的现金流」下降了。

collocations: forecast cash flow available for debt service
calculate cash flow available for debt service
compare cash flow available for debt service with repayments

words.enDefinition: Cash available for debt service divided by debt payments due

examples.en: The debt service coverage ratio fell in the year with the largest scheduled repayment.
examples.zh: 在计划还款额最大的一年，「偿债覆盖率」下降了。

examples.en: Our class compared the debt service coverage ratio across three operating years in the model.
examples.zh: 全班比较了模型中三个运营年度的「偿债覆盖率」。

collocations: calculate the debt service coverage ratio
a minimum debt service coverage ratio
track the debt service coverage ratio

words.enDefinition: the present value of cash flow available for debt service through loan maturity divided by the outstanding loan balance

examples.en: The loan life coverage ratio used forecast cash only through the scheduled loan maturity date.
examples.zh: 「贷款期限偿债覆盖率」只用了截至贷款计划到期日的预测现金流。

examples.en: We checked the outstanding balance used in the loan life coverage ratio during class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上核对了计算「贷款期限偿债覆盖率」使用的未偿余额。

collocations: calculate the loan life coverage ratio
assess the loan life coverage ratio
test a loan life coverage ratio

words.zhGloss: 项目寿命期偿债覆盖率
words.enDefinition: the present value of cash flow available for debt service over the remaining project life divided by outstanding debt
acceptedZhAnswers: 项目寿命期偿债覆盖率

examples.en: The project life coverage ratio used years that fell after the scheduled loan maturity.
examples.zh: 「项目寿命期偿债覆盖率」计入了贷款计划到期后的年份。

examples.en: The exercise calculated the project life coverage ratio using the remaining plant life.
examples.zh: 练习用工厂剩余寿命计算了「项目寿命期偿债覆盖率」。

collocations: calculate the project life coverage ratio
report the project life coverage ratio
compare the project life coverage ratio

words.enDefinition: Designing the repayment schedule to match expected project cash flow

examples.en: The example used debt sculpting to schedule larger repayments in stronger years.
examples.zh: 示例用「按现金流安排还债」的方法，在现金流较好的年份安排更高还款额。

examples.en: Our tutor used debt sculpting to explain the uneven principal schedule.
examples.zh: 导师用「按现金流安排还债」说明为什么本金还款计划各期不等额。

words.enDefinition: The agreed order for allocating a project's available cash to obligations

examples.en: The cash waterfall put lender payments ahead of any distribution to sponsors.
examples.zh: 「资金分配顺序」先安排偿还贷款，再向发起人分配收益。

examples.en: The diagram showed where reserve deposits entered the cash waterfall during the year.
examples.zh: 图上标出了本年度计提存入储备金在「资金分配顺序」中的位置。

words.enDefinition: An account holding money for scheduled payments if project cash falls short

examples.en: The model funded a debt service reserve account before allowing distributions to equity holders.
examples.zh: 模型先充实「债务偿付储备账户」，再允许向股东分配收益。

examples.en: We checked the balance of the debt service reserve account after the weaker sales period.
examples.zh: 销售表现较弱的一段时间过去后，我们核对了「债务偿付储备账户」的余额。

collocations: fund a debt service reserve account
top up the debt service reserve account
draw on the debt service reserve account

words.enDefinition: An additional deposit restoring a reserve account to its required balance

examples.en: The model showed a reserve account top-up after funds had covered the scheduled payment.
examples.zh: 资金用于偿付计划还款后，模型列出一笔「储备账户补足款」。

examples.en: The reserve account top-up reduced cash left for distribution in our example.
examples.zh: 示例里，「储备账户补足款」减少了可分配现金。

collocations: allow for a reserve account top-up

words.enDefinition: A requirement to use some extra operating cash to repay debt

examples.en: The model used a cash sweep in years with extra operating cash.
examples.zh: 模型在经营现金有盈余的年份安排「剩余现金优先还债」。

examples.en: The cash allocated to sponsors fell after the cash sweep in our example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，执行「剩余现金优先还债」后，分给发起人的现金减少了。

collocations: repay debt through a cash sweep

words.enDefinition: A restriction on payments to owners until agreed conditions are met

examples.en: The model showed a distribution lock-up while the reserve balance was below target.
examples.zh: 储备余额低于目标时，模型显示触发了「股东分配暂停条款」。

examples.en: We found the distribution lock-up in the part of the agreement on distributions.
examples.zh: 我们在协议的收益分配章节里找到了「股东分配暂停条款」。

words.zhGloss: 贷款到期后的项目余期
words.enDefinition: The interval between scheduled loan maturity and the project's expected end
acceptedZhAnswers: 贷款到期后的项目余期

examples.en: The schedule left a loan tail after the final planned loan instalment.
examples.zh: 进度表显示，最终一笔计划还款之后仍有一段「贷款到期后的项目余期」。

examples.en: Our example's loan tail ended when the concession period expired.
examples.zh: 示例中的「贷款到期后的项目余期」在特许经营期届满时结束。

collocations: compare the loan tail across proposals

words.enDefinition: The possibility that replacement funding is unavailable or more expensive

examples.en: The worksheet discussed refinancing risk when the full balance fell due before the concession ended.
examples.zh: 练习表讨论了贷款在特许经营结束前就全额到期时的「再融资风险」。

examples.en: Our class identified refinancing risk in a case with a short funding term.
examples.zh: 全班在一则融资期限较短的案例中识别出了「再融资风险」。

words.enDefinition: Conversion of construction borrowing to a term loan after specified milestones

examples.en: The case scheduled construction-to-term conversion after the plant passed its completion tests.
examples.zh: 案例把「建设贷款转长期贷款」安排在工厂通过完工测试之后。

examples.en: Our diagram placed construction-to-term conversion between construction funding and the repayment schedule.
examples.zh: 我们的图把「建设贷款转长期贷款」放在建设资金与还款进度表之间。

words.enDefinition: Determining how much debt anticipated project cash flows can support

examples.en: The class used debt sizing to estimate how much principal the project could support.
examples.zh: 全班通过「项目贷款规模测算」估出了项目能够负担多少本金。

examples.en: The sensitivity chart showed how the demand estimate affected debt sizing.
examples.zh: 敏感性分析图显示了需求预估对「项目贷款规模测算」的影响。

words.enDefinition: The point when financing documents are signed and initial funding conditions satisfied

examples.en: The model assumed financial close occurred before the first construction spending.
examples.zh: 模型假设「融资交割」发生在首笔施工支出之前。

examples.en: Our tutor marked financial close on the project's timeline beside the financing documents.
examples.zh: 导师把「融资交割」标在项目时间轴上，旁边是各份融资文件。

words.enDefinition: Requirements that must be met before a borrower can receive funds

examples.en: The checklist included insurance records among the conditions precedent to drawdown for the construction loan.
examples.zh: 清单把保险记录列为这笔建设贷款的「提款先决条件」之一。

examples.en: Our sample schedule listed the conditions precedent to drawdown separately from later reporting duties.
examples.zh: 我们的进度表样本把「提款先决条件」和后续报告义务分开列出。

collocations: meet the conditions precedent to drawdown

words.enDefinition: A contract granting rights to operate a facility or service

examples.en: The concession agreement set out who could operate the bus terminal.
examples.zh: 「特许经营协议」规定了谁可以运营公交总站。

examples.en: Our class found the handback provisions in the draft concession agreement.
examples.zh: 全班在「特许经营协议」草案里找到了移交条款。

words.enDefinition: The agreed span during which a concession remains in force

examples.en: The concession period ended before the last year in our demand forecast.
examples.zh: 「特许经营期限」在需求预测的最后一年之前就结束了。

examples.en: We marked the end of the concession period on the project timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在项目时间轴上标出了「特许经营期限」的终点。

collocations: the end of the concession period
cash flows over the concession period

words.enDefinition: A contract for a buyer to purchase a project's output

examples.en: The offtake agreement described how the buyer would pay for delivered output.
examples.zh: 「项目产出承购协议」说明了买方怎样为交付的产出付款。

examples.en: We included revenue covered by the offtake agreement in its own row.
examples.zh: 我们把「项目产出承购协议」涵盖的收入单独列了一行。

words.enDefinition: A buyer that agrees to take output from a project

examples.en: The offtaker in our case agreed to buy the plant's output.
examples.zh: 案例中的「项目产出承购方」同意购买工厂的产出。

examples.en: We noted which offtaker was responsible for the contracted payments.
examples.zh: 我们记下了由哪家「项目产出承购方」支付合同款项。

words.enDefinition: An agreement governing the sale of electricity from a generator

examples.en: The power purchase agreement specified who would buy the electricity and how prices moved.
examples.zh: 「电力购买协议」明确了购电方是谁，以及电价怎样调整。

examples.en: The course used a power purchase agreement from an illustrative solar project.
examples.zh: 课程采用了一份示例太阳能项目的「电力购买协议」。

collocations: sell under a power purchase agreement
tariffs under a power purchase agreement

words.enDefinition: A provision requiring minimum payment even if contracted supply goes unused

examples.en: The take-or-pay clause kept a minimum payment in the lower demand case.
examples.zh: 在需求较低的情景下，「照付不议条款」仍保证最低付款。

examples.en: Our workbook showed the receipts linked to the take-or-pay clause separately.
examples.zh: 我们的练习册把与「照付不议条款」关联的收款单列出来。

words.zhGloss: 未锁定收入的市场敞口
words.enDefinition: Exposure to uncontracted revenue depending on market prices or demand
acceptedZhAnswers: 未锁定收入的市场敞口

examples.en: The exercise showed merchant exposure after the fixed price electricity contract expired.
examples.zh: 练习显示，固定电价合同到期后，项目出现了「未锁定收入的市场敞口」。

examples.en: The lender model separated contracted income from revenue subject to merchant exposure.
examples.zh: 贷款机构的模型把合同收入与面临「未锁定收入的市场敞口」的收入区分开。

words.enDefinition: A payment tied to making a facility available to agreed standards

examples.en: The availability payment fell in the example after one facility became unavailable.
examples.zh: 本例中，一处设施无法使用后，「按可用性支付的款项」减少了。

examples.en: The contract linked the availability payment to opening hours and service standards.
examples.zh: 合同把「按可用性支付的款项」与开放时间和服务标准挂钩。

words.enDefinition: A commitment to make up some revenue below a specified level

examples.en: The case included a minimum revenue guarantee tied to traffic on the road.
examples.zh: 案例列了一项和道路车流量挂钩的「最低收入保障」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained which shortfalls the minimum revenue guarantee covered in the model.
examples.zh: 导师解释了模型中的「最低收入保障」涵盖哪些收入缺口。

collocations: support under a minimum revenue guarantee

words.enDefinition: The possibility that actual use or sales differ from forecasts

examples.en: The agreement left demand risk with the project company in the example.
examples.zh: 示例协议把「需求风险」留给项目公司承担。

examples.en: We discussed demand risk before modelling revenue from fares in the case.
examples.zh: 为案例建模估算车费收入前，我们讨论了「需求风险」。

words.enDefinition: Revenue due under already agreed arrangements with buyers or counterparties

examples.en: Our worksheet showed contracted revenue separately from sales at future market prices.
examples.zh: 我们的练习表把「合同约定收入」和按未来市价销售产生的收入分开显示。

examples.en: The lender stress tested contracted revenue after considering risks to the contract.
examples.zh: 贷款机构考虑合同风险后，对「合同约定收入」做了压力测试。

collocations: separate contracted revenue from market sales

words.enDefinition: A gradual increase in revenue after a project begins operating

examples.en: The revenue ramp-up lasted longer when the second station opened later.
examples.zh: 第二个车站晚开后，「收入逐步爬升」的阶段延长了。

examples.en: We moved the end of the revenue ramp-up in the revised schedule.
examples.zh: 我们在修订后的时间表中调整了「收入逐步爬升」的结束时间。

words.zhGloss: 工程采购施工总承包合同
words.enDefinition: One contract covering the design, sourcing, and building of a project
acceptedZhAnswers: 工程采购施工总承包合同

examples.en: The sample engineering, procurement and construction contract listed the contractor's three main duties.
examples.zh: 「工程采购施工总承包合同」样本列出了承包商的三项主要职责。

examples.en: We checked the delivery date in the engineering, procurement and construction contract before reviewing project costs.
examples.zh: 审阅项目成本前，我们核对了「工程采购施工总承包合同」中的交付日期。

collocations: award an engineering, procurement and construction contract
negotiate an engineering, procurement and construction contract
obligations under an engineering, procurement and construction contract

words.enDefinition: A fixed price agreement to deliver a completed usable facility

examples.en: The example used a fixed-price turnkey contract for the complete pumping station.
examples.zh: 示例对整座泵站采用了「固定总价交钥匙合同」。

examples.en: Our group compared a fixed-price turnkey contract with a different construction tender structure.
examples.zh: 我们组将「固定总价交钥匙合同」与另一种施工招标安排作了对照。

collocations: cost under a fixed-price turnkey contract

words.enDefinition: A contract setting out responsibility for operating and maintaining a facility

examples.en: The operations and maintenance agreement explained who would inspect the site after construction.
examples.zh: 「运营维护协议」说明了工程完工后由谁检查场地。

examples.en: The template put the fee under the operations and maintenance agreement beside forecast operating costs.
examples.zh: 模板把「运营维护协议」项下的收费列在预计运营成本旁。

collocations: sign an operations and maintenance agreement
services under an operations and maintenance agreement
review an operations and maintenance agreement

words.enDefinition: Authorisation for a contractor to start work on an agreed scope

examples.en: The schedule began on the day the notice to proceed was issued.
examples.zh: 工程进度从发出「开工指令」的当天开始计算。

examples.en: We found the notice to proceed on the timeline after contract signing.
examples.zh: 我们在合同签署之后的时间线上找到了「开工指令」。

collocations: work after the notice to proceed

words.enDefinition: A check that a completed asset meets agreed operating requirements

examples.en: The completion test in the example checked whether the pumps met capacity requirements.
examples.zh: 示例里的「完工验收测试」检查了泵能否达到规定的能力。

examples.en: We placed the completion test before the first day of the operating period.
examples.zh: 我们把「完工验收测试」安排在运营期第一天之前。

collocations: the results of a completion test

words.enDefinition: The contract date when an asset enters commercial service after meeting requirements

examples.en: The model began charging the service fee at the commercial operation date.
examples.zh: 模型从「商业运营起始日」开始计收服务费。

examples.en: We adjusted the commercial operation date after reading about the delayed equipment test.
examples.zh: 读到设备测试延期后，我们调整了「商业运营起始日」。

words.enDefinition: A promise to support completion or cover agreed costs if it fails

examples.en: The sponsor provided a completion guarantee for the building phase in our case.
examples.zh: 在案例中，发起人为建设阶段提供了「完工保证」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed where the completion guarantee ended on the project timeline.
examples.zh: 导师在项目时间轴上指出了「完工保证」何时结束。

words.enDefinition: Contractually predetermined damages payable for qualifying late completion or delivery

examples.en: The contract listed delay liquidated damages beside the deadline for completing the works.
examples.zh: 合同在工程竣工期限旁写了「约定的延期赔偿额」。

examples.en: We modelled delay liquidated damages separately from the proceeds of the completed project.
examples.zh: 我们把「约定的延期赔偿额」与完工后项目所得分开建模。

words.zhGloss: 约定的性能不达标赔偿额
words.enDefinition: Contractually predetermined damages for failing to achieve defined performance levels
acceptedZhAnswers: 约定的性能不达标赔偿额

examples.en: The example provided for performance liquidated damages if the plant failed its output tests.
examples.zh: 本例规定，工厂产出测试不达标时须付「约定的性能不达标赔偿额」。

examples.en: Our group identified performance liquidated damages in the contract's performance section.
examples.zh: 我们组在合同的性能章节里找出了「约定的性能不达标赔偿额」。

collocations: a clause on performance liquidated damages

words.enDefinition: Contractual rights for lenders to intervene under specified project problems

examples.en: The guide discussed lender step-in rights in its example of an operator default.
examples.zh: 指南用运营方违约案例讨论了「贷款方介入权」。

examples.en: We highlighted the contract clauses describing lender step-in rights in the fictional project.
examples.zh: 我们标出了虚构项目合同中描述「贷款方介入权」的条款。

words.enDefinition: An agreement giving project lenders rights with a key contract party

examples.en: The direct agreement set out when the lender could intervene with the operator.
examples.zh: 「项目贷款方直接协议」规定了贷款方什么时候可以介入运营。

examples.en: We noted which parties had signed the direct agreement in the case.
examples.zh: 我们记下了案例中有哪些当事方签了「项目贷款方直接协议」。

collocations: lender rights under a direct agreement

words.enDefinition: Payment due when an agreement ends early under specified circumstances

examples.en: The scenario calculated termination compensation because the concession ended before its scheduled date.
examples.zh: 由于特许经营提前结束，情景分析计算了「合同终止补偿」。

examples.en: The draft agreement stated who would pay termination compensation in the example.
examples.zh: 协议草案写明了示例中由谁支付「合同终止补偿」。

words.enDefinition: Money set aside to meet required asset condition at handover

examples.en: The handback reserve covered planned repairs before the facility returned to public control.
examples.zh: 特许设施交回公共部门前，「移交准备金」支付了计划中的修缮费用。

examples.en: Our table placed deposits to the handback reserve near the end of the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们的表把存入「移交准备金」的款项安排在协议快到期时。

collocations: the balance of the handback reserve

words.enDefinition: The required state of an asset when returned after a concession

examples.en: The handback condition specified how well the lights and road surface must function.
examples.zh: 「约定的移交状态」规定了路面和照明必须达到的标准。

examples.en: Our group read the handback condition before estimating the repair work.
examples.zh: 我们组先读了「约定的移交状态」，再估算需要修缮的工程。

collocations: comply with the agreed handback condition

words.enDefinition: An amount added to estimated costs for uncertain project expenses

examples.en: The model added a project contingency allowance to the provisional construction estimate.
examples.zh: 模型在暂估建设费上加了「项目预备费」。

examples.en: We checked whether the project contingency allowance covered unforeseen work in our case.
examples.zh: 我们核对了该案例的「项目预备费」是否涵盖未预见的工程。

collocations: costs covered by a project contingency allowance

words.enDefinition: A shortfall when operating income does not cover operating expenses

examples.en: The first operating year showed an operating deficit because revenue rose slowly.
examples.zh: 第一运营年收入增长缓慢，出现了「运营收支赤字」。

examples.en: The spreadsheet showed how the operating deficit changed after demand estimates fell.
examples.zh: 电子表格显示，需求预估下降后，「运营收支赤字」如何变化。

collocations: an operating deficit in the first year

words.enDefinition: The total cost of acquiring, operating, and disposing of an asset

examples.en: The life-cycle cost included a renewal of the pipes after several years.
examples.zh: 「全寿命周期成本」计入了若干年后的管道更换费用。

examples.en: We calculated the life-cycle cost before comparing the two designs in class.
examples.zh: 课上比较两个设计之前，我们计算了「全寿命周期成本」。

words.enDefinition: A technical report assessing project matters independently for interested parties

examples.en: The lenders read the independent engineer's report before reviewing the completion forecast.
examples.zh: 贷款机构在审查完工预测前，阅读了「独立工程师报告」。

examples.en: Our worksheet referred to an independent engineer's report when describing the equipment checks.
examples.zh: 练习表在描述设备检查时引用了「独立工程师报告」。

collocations: findings in an independent engineer's report

words.enDefinition: A long-term public and private arrangement for infrastructure or services

examples.en: We studied a public-private partnership that financed and operated a local road.
examples.zh: 我们研究了一个为当地道路融资并负责运营的「公私合作模式」案例。

examples.en: The course compared two contract models for a public-private partnership in infrastructure.
examples.zh: 课程比较了基础设施「公私合作模式」的两种合同安排。

words.enDefinition: A table showing which parties bear specific risks under a project

examples.en: The risk allocation matrix assigned construction risks and demand risks to different parties.
examples.zh: 「风险分担矩阵」把建设风险和需求风险分给不同当事方。

examples.en: I checked the risk allocation matrix before modelling losses in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我在练习中估算损失前，先核对了「风险分担矩阵」。
